question: Who was awarded the "Cricketer of the Year" in the male category at the BCCI Naman Awards ceremony following the Champions Trophy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shubman Gill**__.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **BCCI Naman Awards**, held on **January 23, 2024**, in **Hyderabad**, recognized the top performers in Indian cricket from the **2019-20** to **2022-23** seasons after a four-year hiatus.
 
• **Shubman Gill**, the **24-year-old** Indian opening batsman, was honored with the prestigious **Polly Umrigar Award** for the **Best International Cricketer (Men)** for the **2022-23** season.
 
• During the **2022-23** period, **Shubman Gill** became the **youngest** player to score a **double century** in **One Day Internationals (ODIs)**, achieving this feat against **New Zealand** in **January 2023**.
 
• His performance was exceptional across all formats, including being the **leading run-scorer** in **ODIs** in the **year 2023**, accumulating over **1,500 runs** in that calendar year alone.
 
• The award ceremony was attended by the entire **Indian Cricket Team** and several former legends, highlighting the **Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI)**'s initiative to celebrate domestic and international excellence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Other Polly Umrigar Award Winners (Men):**

 
 
• **Mohammed Shami** was awarded the **Cricketer of the Year** for the **2019-20** season for his lethal pace bowling and contribution to India's **Test** and **ODI** victories.
 
• **Ravichandran Ashwin** received the award for the **2020-21** season, acknowledging his **all-round performance** and becoming one of the fastest to reach **400 Test wickets**.
 
• **Jasprit Bumrah** was named the winner for the **2021-22** season, recognized for his impact as a **premier strike bowler** across different conditions, especially in **England** and **South Africa**.
 
 
 
• **Women's Category Highlights:**
 
 
• **Deepti Sharma** won the **Best International Cricketer (Women)** award for the seasons **2019-20** and **2022-23**.
 
• **Smriti Mandhana**, the elegant left-handed opener, secured the same award for the **2020-21** and **2021-22** seasons.
 
 
 
• **Lifetime Achievement Awards:**
 
 
• The **Col. C.K. Nayudu Lifetime Achievement Award** was conferred upon former Indian captain and coach **Ravi Shastri** and former wicket-keeper **Farokh Engineer** for their legendary service to **Indian Cricket**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **BCCI Organization:** The **Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI)** is the national governing body for cricket in India, established in **December 1928** and headquartered at the **Wankhede Stadium** in **Mumbai**.
 
• **Polly Umrigar:** The **Cricketer of the Year** trophy is named after **Pahlan Ratanji "Polly" Umrigar**, a legendary Indian cricketer who was the first Indian to score a **Test double century** and captained the national side in the **1950s**.
 
• **Award Criteria:** The winners are selected based on their statistical performance, including **runs scored**, **wickets taken**, and overall impact in **International Cricket** during the specified **BCCI** domestic and international seasons.
 
• **Emerging Talent:** Other notable mentions at the **2024 ceremony** included **Yashasvi Jaiswal**, who won the **Best International Debut** award for the **2022-23** season following his stellar performance in the **West Indies**.
